commit.message:
ref: Type check postprocessworker.py (#40819)

This caused a bug earlier that could have been caught by the type checker (fixed in https://github.com/getsentry/sentry/pull/40818). This file will be removed soon but let's type check it anyway to prevent this occurring again.
